caption: Figure 1: Model architecture with two channels for an example sentence.
description:
## Section 1: Figure Description
This figure illustrates the architecture of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for sentence classification. It shows a model with two channels processing an example sentence. The first channel represents the sentence with static and non-static channels. The second channel demonstrates a convolutional layer with multiple filter widths and feature maps, followed by max-over-time pooling and a fully connected layer with dropout and softmax output.
